hypothesis: Replacing LingBot-VA's Wan2.2 shared block stack with MiniMax-H3 while preserving its four-stream mask will keep two-step updates finite and reduce action loss over a 10-step warmup canary without destabilizing video loss.
single_variable: Use MiniMax-H3 as the single Transformer body shared by noisy/clean video/action tokens; retain the existing verified LIBERO dense cache and velocity objectives.
parent_baseline: E15 independent-ActionDiT full50 real-dense smoke: step1/2 action loss 33.1296/7505.0068 and action gradient norm 5.87e5/3.81e7.

references.title: Causal World Modeling for Robot Control

architecture.paper: noisy/clean video/action streams interact under causal attention
architecture.upstream_code: all four streams concatenate before and share every WanTransformerBlock
architecture.local: all four streams use every shared MiniMax-H3 block; text/proprio are read-only H3 context
architecture.rationale: This is a backbone port, not a Wan reproduction; H3 uses native self-attended text instead of Wan cross-attention.

architecture.paper: action has an independent copied time embedding
architecture.upstream_code: condition_embedder_action is a deepcopy of video conditioning
architecture.local: action time embedder is a deepcopy of H3 video time embedder and action rows use unused H3 audio AdaLN tag 2
architecture.rationale: H3 exposes only three pretrained modality rows; tag 2 is unused because this canary has no audio tokens and provides distinct action modulation without adding a random Transformer body.

data.upstream_code: LeRobot action segments paired to cached latent segments
data.local: episode-disjoint v7 dense cache; 200779 train windows and fixed val40 manifest; canary uses one real window per rank
data.rationale: Both consume dense temporal windows; H3 latent frames are explicitly mapped to the same eight action chunks instead of copying Wan VAE frame geometry.

action.upstream_code: 30D carrier with seven active normalized LIBERO dimensions
action.local: direct seven active dimensions, min-max normalized, horizon 32
action.rationale: The 23 inactive upstream carrier channels are masked from loss and carry no policy information.

objective.upstream_code: latent velocity MSE plus masked action velocity MSE
objective.local: future-video velocity MSE plus action velocity MSE
objective.rationale: Both targets are noise minus clean sample under linear flow interpolation.

optimization.upstream_code: AdamW, lr 1e-5, beta2 0.95, weight decay 0.1, 10-step warmup, global batch 10, 5000 steps
optimization.local: AdamW, tail-2 H3 lr 1e-6, beta2 0.95, 10-step warmup, global batch 8, 10 steps
optimization.rationale: This is only a finite-update and checkpoint gate for a 33B backbone; it cannot establish policy quality.

evaluation.upstream_code: LIBERO client rollout with observation feedback
evaluation.local: 10-step gradient/checkpoint smoke; episode-disjoint val and fixed rollout remain required before GO_LONG
evaluation.rationale: The canary is an engineering gate and makes no effectiveness claim.

evidence: shared-backbone code audit and 34 related unit tests
v7 dense cache and episode-disjoint fixed manifests
seven active LIBERO channels verified against upstream carrier mask
real velocity heads and targets in full50 smoke
pre-registered numeric stop gate; no rollout claim from smoke
action loss reaches shared H3; video loss reaches action embedding unit tests
real full50 s1 loss 1.2611, H3/action grad 0.2209/8.1456
independent-process restore action loss 1.072317 from saved s10 stage
shared block receives joint gradients without independent action body

decision.rationale: Official shared-block architecture, causal mask, real data, gradient paths and full50 FSDP smoke pass; run only a 10-step warmup/checkpoint canary.
